title: dnd-5e-2024 class feature stats (docs/rulesets.md#classes)
description: A component of a class or subclass (docs/content-model.md#components): one feature, printed "Level 1: Rage" on its parent's page and named in the class's Features table at each of its levels.

levels.description: The levels it appears at in the Features table, ascending. The first is the one it's described at; the rest repeat it. A level with a note prints the note in parentheses after the name in that row: "Mystic Arcanum (level 6 spell)".

text.description: The feature as printed: its titled paragraphs and tables, with tokens.
